pr_title: [contextmenus] Add missing context menu items from properties/plugins
pr_body:
## Description
Context menu items might be set on fileItem properties (the case of plugins). This is done with property pairs `contextmenulabel` and `contextmenuaction`. However these menu items are only parsed on media windows - where the contextmenu dialog is invoked with a vector of items for displaying. The generic implementation in the contextmenu manager (when showing context menu items for a given fileitem) does not include them. For this reason, on content widgets, plugin listitem's context menus are not being shown.

## Motivation and context
Fix https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/21843

## How has this been tested?
With the procedure outlined on the bug report, in linux.

## What is the effect on users?
Plugin context menu items are now displayed in content widgets with plugin:// paths. Other cases might be fixed as well.

## Screenshots (if appropriate):
**Before:**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7375276/190505949-dd2ebdd8-6adc-4cea-a797-206a973444b6.png)

**Now:**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7375276/190505164-064b45d6-4908-4c15-8d17-c1e1dea49d1a.png)

Just a note this doesn't affect the context menu items on plugin browsing:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7375276/190506374-39b33a4b-9b88-436b-b7bd-cbf033823d66.png)

review_comments: maybe this can be a private helper `CContextButtons GetPropertyMenuButtons(const CFileItem& item) const` or something.

It's not easy because the context action is not part of the button, they're rather a simple label. As a result this is hard to encapsulate as later on you'll have to use the index to send the built-in message. I think it's better to try to reuse this method in media windows instead of duplicating the logic there
